description: Discover French online stores where an AI agent can actually buy, filtered by PROVEN facts, in one sector or all of them. Use it when the user asks where to buy something online in France, which stores allow guest checkout, or which show the delivered price. To look up a store by name, use rechercher_marchand; for a whole sector ranking, classement_secteur. Every filter is optional; set a boolean to true to require that fact. Returns: secteur, criteres (filters applied), total (number of matching stores) and marchands, best score first, at most limite entries, each with rang, ex_aequo, secteur, domaine, nom, note out of 100, the five facts as booleans (sans_compte, prix_livre, frais_livraison, retours, ucp_commande), dernier_test and page. No match: total 0 and an empty list.

langue.description: Language of the page links and, for consulter_marchand, of the summary sentence: fr (default) or en. Data fields are the same in both.

limite.description: Maximum number of stores returned (default 20, at most 50); total still counts every match.

prix_livre.description: Total price including delivery was shown before any sign-up.

retours.description: Return policy was found and quoted.

sans_compte.description: Agent reached checkout without creating an account (proven by a screenshot or quote).

secteur.description: Restrict to one sector; all sectors if omitted.

ucp.description: Store publishes a UCP profile that declares checkout, so an agent can order through the protocol.

name: trouver_marchands
title: Trouver des marchands par critères
